listings.carSeatNotes: Full-size sedan - the roomiest rear bench here with easy LATCH access; rear-facing installs with tons of clearance, and a big trunk for daycare bags.
listings.nextAction: Private seller - ask for the VIN, mileage and a title photo; Avalon Hybrid uses the proven Camry Hybrid drivetrain, so confirm hybrid-battery health.
listings.why: Best family car on the list: full-size, quiet and safe (5-star NHTSA, only 2 recalls) with ~40 mpg. Reconfirmed live on Facebook this run at $7,500 near Denver. Ask the seller for mileage.

listings.carSeatNotes: Midsize sedan with a wide rear bench and easy LATCH - rear-facing seat fits comfortably; large trunk.
listings.nextAction: Dealer - request the free Carfax and confirm the model-year recalls were performed; verify hybrid-battery health.
listings.why: Lowest miles of any car here (89k) at $7,350 and one of the closest listings (6 mi). 5-star NHTSA, roomy midsize sedan, ~37 mpg. Excellent low-mileage value for a young family. Reconfirmed live this run.

listings.carSeatNotes: Modern Prius liftback - roomy rear seat with top-tether and LATCH; rear-facing fits well and the big hatch swallows a stroller and daycare bags.
listings.nextAction: Dealer - request the Carfax; confirm it is the plug-in Prime (25 mi EV range) and check that the ~62k miles match service records.
listings.why: By far the newest, safest and most efficient car on the list: a 2022 plug-in with ~25 mi electric range (covers the daily commute on the home L1 outlet), 54 mpg after that, 5-star NHTSA and 0 open recalls. Reconfirmed live this run at $9,250.

listings.carSeatNotes: Midsize sedan with a roomy rear bench and easy LATCH access - rear-facing seat fits comfortably.
